_note: Every engine Murage ships, enumerated from server/drivers/builtIn.ts at 750518f6c (19 drivers, 20 gate rows because OpenCode and Grok each have two names). auth: subscription = interactive CLI login by Sean, once per host; flux = Flux test account 052be274 via FluxRouter (key file on the host, never 63c3bfa0); none = cannot be exercised by the gate. hosts: true or a reason string. FLUX table = server/flux-routing.ts FLUX_CAPABILITY.

hosts.win: driver ships no Windows installer (curl x.ai/cli/install.sh only)

droid.signIn: droid  (first run opens the Factory browser/device login; creates ~/.factory/auth.v2.*)

opencode.signIn: none: the gate writes an OpenAI-compatible provider 'fluxgate' into the gate account's own ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json with apiKey {file:<flux-test.key>} (Sean has no OpenCode subscription; the product's own Flux connector connectOpenCodeFlux has no caller on desktop in 1.0.3)

antigravity.signIn: agy  (first run: Google sign-in, device flow)

pi.signIn: pi  then /login inside pi (choose a subscription provider)

hermes.signIn: hermes setup  (provider = FluxRouter) OR gate runs it on the Flux key

qwen.signIn: none: the gate injects the Flux key (qwen consumer OAuth is retired)

openclaw.signIn: openclaw onboard  (choose the provider login; verify with openclaw status)

gemini.unexercised: needs GEMINI_API_KEY, Vertex or an enterprise Code Assist login; consumer Google logins ended 2026-06-18; not Flux-routable; Sean's rule is subscription logins only. Re-enable by adding an enterprise login to the host and setting auth to subscription.

grok-api.unexercised: API-key-only (XAI_API_KEY), vendor-only on Flux, subscription-only rule. The Grok CLI row (grokcli) covers the same vendor.

minimax.unexercised: API-key-only (mmx auth login --api-key), no Flux route, no subscription login.

custom-acp.unexercised: user-supplied ACP command; there is no fixed binary to gate. Every ACP engine above runs the same core.ts path.

boxagent.unexercised: 'Computer' engine runs on Murage Cloud (cloud VM); gated by the cloud-v2 lane, not a local-host gate.
